IS 411: 2026 Titanium Dioxide for Pigmentary Applications - Specification
ICS 87.060.10
ICS 87.060.10
CHD 21
CHD 21
(Superseding IS 9788 : 2023)
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for titanium dioxide, anatase/rutile, used as a pigment in industry.
1.2 This standard is not applicable to titanium dioxide intended for use in food products and cosmetic applications.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
